statement:
Let $P$ be a finite complete affine-lattice base, $m=|P|$, $d\ge1$, $N=d+1$, and $\gamma_d=(d/(d+1))^d$. Range over all actual positive compatible convex $d$-fibers $K_z$ at $z\in P$, with volumes $V_z$, total mass $M$, and ordinary maximum normalized closed-halfspace depth $\beta_0(K)$. Let $\beta_0^*=\inf_K\beta_0(K)<b$. Assume the original sublevel $\{\beta_0\le b\}$ admits a compact positive representative frame under invertible maps $(z,X)\mapsto(z,AX+s(z))$ with $s$ affine, with $M=1$, $V_z\ge v>0$ and $K_z\subset RB_d$ in the frame. Write $L=m\kappa_{d-1}R^{d-1}$, where $\kappa_j$ is the unit $j$-ball volume and $\kappa_0=1$.

Take positive affine $\ell$ on $\operatorname{conv}(P)$ with $\sum_z w_z\log\ell_z=0$, where $w_z=V_z/M$. Put $A_\ell=\sum_z w_z\ell_z$. Let $\beta_\varepsilon$ be the maximum normalized depth using unchanged pure-base caps and enlarging every nonvertical through-mark cap at $(p,y)$ by $\varepsilon f(p,y)G_K(u)$ in its affine margin, where $f=(\ell_pE_{K_p}(y)/M)^{1/N}$, $E$ is marked projective energy extended by zero to the own boundary, and $G_K(u)$ is the pooled within-fiber covariance norm. Use the whole-base trace in rank zero.

For all sufficiently small $\varepsilon>0$, the infimum of $J_\varepsilon=\beta_\varepsilon+\varepsilon^2(A_\ell-1)$ is attained and is in $[\beta_0^*,\beta_0^*+\varepsilon LR]$. At every minimizing pair, in the frame,
$$
A_\ell\le1+LR/\varepsilon,\qquad
\varepsilon f(p,y)G_K(u)\le\Delta_\varepsilon:=\varepsilon R(1+LR/\varepsilon)^{1/N}\quad(\|u\|=1).
$$
Put $c=\gamma_d/m$. If $L\Delta_\varepsilon<c/4$, every maximizing mark of $\beta_\varepsilon$ at such a pair has own-boundary distance at least $3c/(4L)$ and every shifted own nonvertical trace cuts the own fiber interior.
title: An arithmetic penalty attains affine-buffer minima with proper own traces
